chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ali ibn Isma'il, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Marriage is only annulled due to leprosy, leprosy (or severe skin disease), madness, and blindness.

key_terms.الْجُذَامِ: leprosy (a more severe or distinct skin disease)
key_terms.يُرَدُّ: annulled or returned (referring to the marriage contract)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific physical defects that allow for marriage annulment in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani’s al--Isfār establishes the principle of 'gharar' (uncertainty) in marriage by specifying defects that, if concealed, allow for annulment. While the chain traces back to Imam al-Sadiq, Shia jurists like al-Murtada and al-Najashi have debated whether these four conditions are exhaustive or illustrative of broader categories of impediments affecting marital compatibility. The ruling underscores the importance of transparency in marital contracts to ensure mutual consent is fully informed.
